description: Hawkr - 評估哪個服務需要 load balance：跨服務比較 + per-pod 流量分佈

panels.title: 🎯 跨服務 Load Balance 評估

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(grpc_server_requests_total[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job, le)) / 1000)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job, le)) / 1000)

(sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(grpc_server_requests_total{code=~"Internal|Unavailable|DataLoss|Unknown|DeadlineExceeded|ResourceExhausted"}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(grpc_server_requests_total[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway",rpc_response_status_code=~"INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DATA_LOSS|UNKNOWN|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job)) / (sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(grpc_server_requests_total[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job))

panels.title: 跨服務 Triage 表（依 QPS 排序）

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job, le)) / 1000)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job, le)) or (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job, le)) / 1000)

(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(grpc_server_requests_total{job=~"$job",code=~"Internal|Unavailable|DataLoss|Unknown|DeadlineExceeded|ResourceExhausted"}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(grpc_server_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$job",uri!~"/actuator.*",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$job",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(calls_total{job=~"$job",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway",rpc_response_status_code=~"INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DATA_LOSS|UNKNOWN|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}[5m])) by (job) or 0 * sum(rate(calls_total{job=~"$job",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job)) / (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(grpc_server_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$job",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (job) or sum(rate(calls_total{job=~"$job",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",job!="hawkr-gateway"}[5m])) by (job))

panels.title: ⚖️ 同服務 Per-Pod 流量分佈（$job 副本間比較）

options.content: `pod` label 已於 2026-08-20 confirm 生效（SSH 進監控機直查 Prometheus `label/pod/values` 有實際 pod name）；**只有 1 條線** = `$job` 確實只有 1 個 replica，不是資料異常。prod 目前僅 gateway / cart-service / payment-service / payuni-webhook-service / order-service 是多副本。**Java job 這兩張圖仍會空白**：Java 的資料源是 spanmetrics（remote-write 進來，沒有 `pod` label），尚未接上這裡。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",pod!=""}[5m])) by (pod, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",pod!=""}[5m])) by (pod, le)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",pod!="",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) by (pod, le))
